# Better Proposals

Better Proposals is a web-based proposal creation tool that enables users to send professionally designed proposals.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/better-proposals/.

## Actions

- **Create Company**: Create a new company.
- **Create Document Type**: Create a new document type.
- **Create Proposal Cover**: Create a new proposal cover design.
- **Get All Companies**: Retrieve a paginated list of all companies.
- **Get All Currencies**: Retrieve a paginated list of all currencies.
- **Get All Document Types**: Retrieve a paginated list of all document types.
- **Get All Document Types**: Retrieve a paginated list of all document types.
- **Get All Proposals**: Retrieve a paginated list of all proposals.
- **Get All Quotes**: Retrieve a paginated list of all quotes.
- **Get All Templates**: Retrieve a paginated list of all templates.
- **Get Brand Settings**: Retrieve settings for the default brand.
- **Get Company**: Retrieve details of a specific company.
- **Get Currency**: Retrieve details of a specific currency.
- **Get New Proposals**: Retrieve all new proposals.
- **Get Opened Proposals**: Retrieve all opened proposals.
- **Get Paid Proposals**: Retrieve all paid proposals.
- **Get Proposal Count**: Retrieve the total count of proposals.
- **Get Quote**: Retrieve details of a specific quote.
- **Get Sent Proposals**: Retrieve all sent proposals.
- **Get Settings**: Retrieve current account settings.
- **Get Signed Proposals**: Retrieve all signed proposals.
- **Get Template Details**: Retrieve details of a specific template.
